metadata.title: The isoperimetric problem for four-dimensional parallelohedra
metadata.abstract: We show that the regular $24$-cell uniquely minimizes surface area among four-dimensional parallelohedra of fixed volume. As a consequence, it also minimizes surface area among parallelohedra containing a fixed ball. Moreover, we establish quadratic Hausdorff stability, and we derive a second-variation formula valid across changes of Voronoi type, which identifies which root-lattice Voronoi cells are strict local minima under metric and affine perturbations.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 四维 parallelohedra 的等周最优性
analysis.workSummary: 证明定体积四维 parallelohedra 中正 24-cell 唯一最小表面积，并得包含固定球情形最优性、二次 Hausdorff 稳定性和跨 Voronoi 类型变化的二阶变分公式。
analysis.breakthrough: 确定四维平行铺空间多胞体的表面积最优模型及稳定性。
analysis.limitations: 优化类为 parallelohedra，不能扩大为所有四维凸体或任意铺砌多胞体。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 GPT-6 Astra 探索收尾步骤的替代启发式，但多数失败，可行候选也不及原方法；模型另提供编辑建议及反馈。
